## Body

Round 1: BLOCK at 0c7649929f8b4837f4d0d131a151077d8d223b79.

R249-001 (P2) - A cached transcript miss can suppress PA size monitoring indefinitely, not just for 30 seconds.
Location: crates/unisphere/src/lib.rs:239-245; consumer crates/daemon/src/pa_presence.rs:995-1043.

The new fast path returns an ordinary NotFound even after the transcript has appeared. PA refresh_sizes treats that reply as a completed CachedSize with tokens=None and stale=false (1039-1043). Its next-round filter skips an unchanged idle seat when that cached entry is fresh (1001-1008).

Concrete sequence: at t=0 a status request misses; the seat's first complete turn creates its transcript and posts its final activity generation before t=20; at t=25 the PA first samples the now-idle seat and receives the adapter's cached miss. At t=85 and later the adapter TTL has expired, but PA never calls it again because the seat is idle, was not seen working in the preceding PA round, and its generation/incarnation/session are unchanged. A now-readable large seat can therefore remain absent from the prime's large-seat FYI and SeatSizes indefinitely, until another activity occurs. Before this PR the t=25 read would inspect the already-present transcript.

Keep transient NotFound results retryable by the PA, or otherwise propagate their bounded freshness/invalidate them so a completed idle turn cannot permanently freeze unknown size. Add one focused regression: miss, transcript appears and final activity lands, PA reads inside MISS_TTL, then another PA round after expiry with no further activity must recover the known size. No new background timer or full idle-fleet reread is needed.

Other requested checks:
- Copilot's explicit path is identical to the SDK's existing successful direct probe for the configured root; its root label/source key and warm cursor path remain the same. The existing present-Copilot test passed in CI. session_roots (daemon/src/lib.rs:1261-1274) still uses HOME/.copilot/session-state; COPILOT_HOME, config-dir and XDG overrides are not honored there before or after this PR. That is an existing scope limitation, not a new regression.
- Miss ownership is per SeatId and full StatusTarget equality (harness, session id, transcript), checked after acquiring the seat lock. A different session therefore bypasses the previous miss. Instant supplies monotonic expiry; an actual successful read clears missed. The target-rollover and consumer-expiry cases are not pinned by the three new tests.
- Ordinary cold-wake checks explicitly allow unknown/not-found and disclose why; known-warm FYI flushing requires positive evidence, and cheap-revive cache checks return unknown rather than assume cold. Compaction-wake decisions use delivery/activity/holdings, not transcript status. PA presence has the blocking interaction above.
- The new unisphere-core direct edge is under dev-dependencies only and the arch allowlist is explicitly unisphere-core@dev. Core already existed transitively through the SDK. Cargo.lock adds only this edge, no new package/source: the existing GitHub Unisphere source remains pinned to 0370cabbe4d9bcbb5b7bf6b0e13a490f0f4d0d59.
- Registration does not itself enforce a path-component grammar, but the pinned SDK status_incremental rejects empty, dot, dot-dot, slash, backslash and NUL session ids before locate/stat. Joining the id does not create a traversal read.
- No added timer, poll or process launch. Cold Copilot misses are one stat and zero walks; cached reads perform no filesystem lookup. A formerly successful cursor whose file disappears can first pay relocate plus locate (two stats), then shares the miss. Non-Copilot misses perform one discovery per configured root per expired seat/target miss, not a bounded number of directory entries. Live cost/CPU proof and remaining root-walk size measurement stay with performance/vast-silkworm.
